news.title: Grant Cardone says he will keep buying bitcoin using real estate cash flows
news.summary: The real estate investor pitched his model as a treasury company backed by cash-flowing property rather than stock sales, framing the slide in bitcoin as a chance to accumulate.

news.title: Ethereum treasury firm Sharplink buys ether for the first time in eight months
news.summary: The second-largest corporate ether holder purchased 5,000 ETH worth about $7.85 million on Thursday, its first inflow since October, even as it sits on a paper loss of roughly $1.8 billion.

news.title: Bitcoin bounces from $58,000 as derivatives signal more pain in the pipeline
news.summary: BTC touched its lowest level since September 2024 before rebounding to $59,770, while ETH slipped further and another $1 billion in futures positions were wiped out.
